{{CharInfobox| |color=525252 |corecolor=8F8F8F |bordercolor=353535 |text=white |name=Jervis |jname=ジェルミ |tmname=Jeremy |image=Jervis.png |caption=Jervis |size=250px |hometown=[[Undella Town]] |region=[[Unova]] |trainer=no |game=no |gender=Male |colors=yes |hair=Gray |eyes=Brown |anime=yes |epnum=BW086 |epname=Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times! |enva=[[Sean Schemmel]] |java=[[Takanori Hoshino]] |}} '''Jervis''' (Japanese: '''ジェルミ''' ''Jeremy'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}. He is {{an|Cynthia}}'s {{wp|butler}} at her villa in [[Undella Town]]. ==History== Jervis debuted in ''[[BW086|Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times!]]'', where he was introduced to {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}} and {{an|Cilan}} shortly after they arrived in Undella Town with Cynthia. He then drove them to Cynthia's villa. Later, when Cilan challenged {{an|Dawn}} to a {{pkmn|battle}} in order to {{pkmn|Connoisseur|evaluate}} the [[Friendship|bond]] between a {{pkmn|Coordinator}} and their {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, Jervis took the role of [[Battle judge|referee]]. He called an official time out once {{an|Meloetta}} interrupted the match after becoming impressed by {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}}'s [[appeal]]ing [[move]]s. In ''[[BW087|Expedition to Onix Island!]]'', Jervis brought {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, who wanted to search for a [[Shiny Pokémon|special]] {{p|Onix}}, to a [[Deserted Island (BW087)|tropical island]] by boat. Before leaving the group, Jervis warned them for the many dangers on the island. At the end of the day, Jervis returned to the island to pick them up and bring them back to Undella Town. In ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', Jervis greeted Ash and his friends as they arrived at Cynthia's villa. In ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', thanks to Jervis's advice, {{un|Cameron}} traveled to the closest [[Gym]] in [[Humilau City]] and went on to earn his eighth and final [[Unova League]] Badge, {{badge|Wave}}. He made cameo appearances from ''[[BW096|Meloetta and the Undersea Temple!]]'' to ''[[BW098|Beauties Battling for Pride and Prestige!]]'', during the entire Operation Tempest arc. He was the one who informed Ash about the location of [[Unova]]'s {{pkmn|League Conference}}, saying the tournament was scheduled to take place in [[Vertress City]]. ==Character== Jervis has a calm and collected personality.
